current_detections.name: Bullish Flag
current_detections.evidence: Strong impulse rally from approximately 1560 to 1705 followed by tight sideways consolidation between 1675 and 1695. Current price 1685.25 is inside the flag formation.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Breakout above flag resistance near 1700 with volume expansion to confirm continuation.

current_detections.name: Symmetrical Triangle
current_detections.evidence: Recent post-rally consolidation shows converging price action with lower highs and higher lows forming early triangle boundaries.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Multiple touches of both trendlines and a decisive breakout above resistance or below support.

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above flag resistance near 1700 with volume expansion to confirm continuation.

tracked_patterns.name: Double Top
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price reached approximately 1710, pulled back to 1675, and is testing resistance near the prior high area.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear second top at similar level and breakdown below neckline support.

tracked_patterns.name: Bullish Pennant
tracked_patterns.evidence: Strong impulsive rally from approximately 1550 to 1700 followed by tight sideways consolidation near resistance, forming converging trendlines characteristic of a pennant.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above upper trendline (~1705-1710) to confirm bullish continuation.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish market structure with higher highs and higher lows is showing weakness at resistance; price is consolidating below the swing high and may break the most recent higher low.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed break below the recent swing low/higher low near 1675 to validate the shift from bullish to bearish structure.

tracked_patterns.name: Ascending Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Series of higher lows since the 1550 swing low approaching flat resistance around 1700-1725.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Decisive breakout above resistance at approximately 1725.

tracked_patterns.name: Symmetrical Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Recent post-rally consolidation shows converging price action with lower highs and higher lows forming early triangle boundaries.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Multiple touches of both trendlines and a decisive breakout above resistance or below support.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish to bullish after price broke above prior swing high near 1675 and established higher highs/higher lows following the 1550 swing low.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: None - structural shift is already visible in price action.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price broke above prior swing high resistance around 1650-1675 during the rally to 1700, indicating bullish BOS.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Sustained close above broken structure level to confirm BOS validity.

tracked_patterns.name: Doji
tracked_patterns.evidence: Latest candles show small bodies with upper and lower wicks around 1680-1690, indicating indecision at resistance.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Candle close to confirm doji formation; latest candle may still be forming.

tracked_patterns.name: Falling Wedge
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price forming lower highs from the 1710 peak and holding support around 1675-1680, suggesting potential converging trendlines.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear trendline convergence and decisive close above upper wedge boundary near 1700.
